name: Alice ~ After Story
source:
What's the future going to be like?

Nik, the protagonist has been living his life like normal, However he keeps having flashbacks of memories that he doesn't recognize.
Who is that mysterious girl? And why are there gaps in his memories?

Alice ~ After Story is the final chapter of [url=https://vndb.org/v39781]Alice[/url].
The game has multiple Endings, but in only one of them you get to find out the truth.
And don't forget...
Every single decision you make is going to affect the future!

[From [url=https://nikvn.itch.io/alice-after-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
未来会是什么样？

主角Nik一直过着平常的生活，却不断闪回一些自己毫无印象的记忆。
那个神秘的女孩是谁？他的记忆又为何存在空白？

《Alice ~ After Story》是[url=https://vndb.org/v39781]《Alice》[/url]的最终章。
游戏有多种结局，但只有其中一种，能让你发现真相。
别忘了……
你的每一个决定，都会影响未来！

[摘自[url=https://nikvn.itch.io/alice-after-story]Itch.io[/url]]
